# Backlog & planning

A backlog that starts threads (with Jira and Notion), goals agents keep working on, schedules and a reorderable queue.

Pack id `planning`. Back to [all packs](README.md).

## Plugins

1. [`@dshfiles/backlog`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/backlog/README.md) — One capture feed for notes, tasks and agent work that organizes and ages itself.
2. [`@dshfiles/backlog-jira`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/backlog-jira/README.md) — Jira Cloud projects as a backlog sync provider: issues, workflow transitions, labels, priority, parents, issue links, due dates, ADF bodies and comments.
3. [`@dshfiles/backlog-notion`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/backlog-notion/README.md) — Notion data sources as a backlog sync provider: pages, status, tags, priority, parent, markdown bodies and comments.
4. [`@dshfiles/goal-tool`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/goal-tool/README.md) — Owned fork of DSH's goal tools that recognizes admitted answers to continued user-question forms
5. [`@dshfiles/schedule`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/schedule/README.md) — Owned native Tasks page and reminder catalogs that keep each catalog read until a schedule change or reconnect.
6. [`@dshfiles/queue-reorder`](../../plugins/@dshfiles/queue-reorder/README.md) — Drag-to-reorder the DSH message queue, using the durable inbox splice rather than remove-and-resend.

## Prerequisites

1. A project is added.

## Key settings

1. **Triage new backlog items automatically**: Settings entry `dshfiles-backlog`, field `autoTriage`.

## Enable it

1. In the app: **Knowledge › Getting started**, then **Enable pack** on Backlog & planning under Packs. It previews exactly what changes; **Disable pack** reverses it.
2. From an Agent: the `onboarding_pack_apply` tool with pack `planning`. It runs only when you ask, after showing the preview.
3. From a shell: `dshx init --profile <name> --packs planning` (Core is added; `--dry-run` previews). See [`dshx init`](../../tooling/dshx/docs/cli-reference.md#dshx-init-compose-a-profile-from-packs).

## Restart

Installing a plugin the profile does not have yet needs a DSH Host restart: DSH reads the profile once at boot. Plugins already installed are switched on in the running DSH. Nothing restarts on its own: use **Restart when idle** in the sidebar when DSH runs under the managed launcher, otherwise your own launcher.
